## Learning Objectives

- Understand what Base R is, and how it differs from the Tidyverse
- Identify R data types and structures  
- Explore R vectors 
- Subset data using Base R syntax


## Readings

* [Chapter 20 “Vectors”](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/vectors.html) in "R for Data Science" 1st Edition. I recommend starting with the 1st Edition, which I find it clearer on this topic, but if you prefer you can instead use [Chapter 12 "Logical Vectors"](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/logicals) and [Chapter 13 "Numbers"](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/numbers) from the 2nd Edition. Choose whichever version works best for you.
* [Chapter 27 "A field guide to base R"](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/base-r) in "R for Data Science" 2nd Edition.
